title: Unified Error Handling Middleware with Structured JSON Responses
description: Introduce a centralized error handling system that captures thrown errors, maps them to appropriate HTTP status codes, and returns a consistent JSON payload. This improves client debugging, simplifies middleware error propagation, and enhances production reliability.
testCases: Verify that a thrown HttpError with status 404 returns a JSON response { error: { status:404, message:'Not Found' } } and sets the correct HTTP status code
Verify that an uncaught generic Error results in a 500 response with a generic message and does not expose stack traces
acceptance: All existing tests continue to pass; new tests for error handling succeed; error responses are consistent JSON with status and message; no stack traces leaked in production mode; middleware logs errors appropriately
reason: Standardizing error responses reduces client-side ambiguity, aids monitoring, and aligns the framework with production best‑practice patterns, addressing a critical gap in the current lightweight stack.
